title: MyFinance — Application Architecture
description: Unified Next.js 15 app: browser and MCP clients, React client tier, /api route handlers dispatching to auth, finance and MCP domains, backed by Neon PostgreSQL.

nodes.label: Web browser
nodes.detail: User's browser; mobile layouts in src/components/mobile/* chosen by useIsMobile

nodes.label: Vercel
nodes.detail: vercel.json framework: nextjs; env DATABASE_URL, APP_ORIGIN. Dev: next dev -p 5173

nodes.label: MCP client
nodes.detail: External MCP client calling /api/mcp (or /api/v1/mcp) with Authorization: Bearer <key> or X-API-Key; keys managed on Profile (McpAccessSection)

nodes.label: App Router
nodes.detail: src/app/layout.tsx + providers.tsx (ThemeProvider, AuthProvider); (auth) login/signup with guest redirect; (finance) persistent shell: calendar, week, day, plans, analytics, profile + QuickEntryDialog, MonthlyIncomeModal

nodes.label: React contexts
nodes.detail: src/contexts: ThemeContext, AuthContext (useSyncExternalStore), FinanceShellContext, FinanceContext (serialized request queue + date-range cache), SettingsContext

nodes.label: API clients
nodes.detail: src/services/auth.ts (session restore, refresh, Web Locks + BroadcastChannel, api-keys); src/services/finance.ts (createFinanceApi: cursor pagination, CRUD)

nodes.label: Shared lib
nodes.detail: src/lib: analytics, salaryCycle, plans, income, repeatRules, calendarWindow, expenseDraft, navigation, pages… also imported by src/server (finance/store, mcp/data, mcp/tools)

nodes.label: Route handlers
nodes.detail: src/app/api/route.ts, api/[...slug]/route.ts, api/mcp/route.ts — every method delegates to app.fetch (src/server/app.ts getApp() singleton)

nodes.label: App engine
nodes.detail: createApplication in src/server/application.ts: Origin check on non-GET (except MCP), JSON body limit 16 KB (128 KB finance/MCP), path dispatch, serviceErrorDiagnostic → safe 503

nodes.label: Auth domain
nodes.detail: src/server/auth: http.ts (/register, /login, /refresh, /logout, /me, /account, /api-keys; authenticateRequest[WithScope]), crypto.ts (scrypt, SHA-256 token hashes), store.ts (Neon)

nodes.label: MCP server
nodes.detail: src/server/mcp: http.ts (JSON-RPC dispatch, Mcp-Session-Id), protocol, tools (spendings, incomes, plans, categories, analytics, forecasts), resources, prompts, data

nodes.label: Finance domain
nodes.detail: src/server/finance: http.ts (/settings, /spendings, /incomes, /repeat-rules, /repeat-rules/sync, /plans), validation.ts, store.ts (Neon), recurrence.ts, model.ts

nodes.label: Finance tables
nodes.detail: finance_settings, finance_spendings (002), finance_income_entries (003, legacy), finance_repeat_rules (004), finance_incomes, finance_income_migrations (005), finance_plans, finance_plan_exceptions (007/008)

cards.title: Clients and hosting
items: Web browser — one origin for pages and /api/v1/* (port 5173 in dev, Vercel in prod)
MCP client — external AI agent; authenticates with a per-user API key (read or write scope)
Vercel — runs the Next.js app; needs DATABASE_URL and APP_ORIGIN

cards.title: Client tier
items: App Router — (finance) layout keeps FinanceProvider, SettingsProvider, nav and modals mounted across page changes
React contexts — FinanceContext serializes requests and caches spendings by date range
API clients — services/auth.ts coordinates token refresh across tabs (Web Locks + BroadcastChannel)
Shared lib — pure logic (plans, analytics, salary cycle, income) reused by the server

cards.title: Server tier
items: Route handlers — thin: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE/OPTIONS all call app.fetch
App engine — CSRF Origin check (skipped for MCP), body size limits, routes by path prefix, sanitized 503 on unexpected errors
Finance domain — every request authenticated via auth/http authenticateRequest
MCP server — authenticateRequestWithScope, then reads/writes through FinanceStore

cards.title: Data
items: Auth tables — scrypt password hashes, SHA-256 hashed access/refresh tokens and API keys
Finance tables — all rows scoped by user_id; schema from migrations/001–008 (npm run db:migrate)
